title: Solving a PDE-constrained antenna design problem by mixed-integer programming
summary: This paper shows that a mixed integer PDE-constrained design optimization problem can be made amenable to be solved to optimality using standard mixed-integer programming solvers. The concrete problem that we consider is the optimal design of the topology of an antenna, a problem that keeps haunting the engineering community. Indeed, up to this point no exact method was known. Existing methods rely on iterative use of PDE-solvers, embedded in either gradient methods or metaheuristics. However, none of these methods come with performance guarantees.
